definitions.explanation: An exclamation of hearty praise for something impressively done, carrying a traditional and somewhat dramatic tone of admiration.

examples.japanese: あっぱれな⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧だった。
⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{諦|あきら}めなかった→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あっぱれだ。
examples.english: The way they didn't give up until the end is admirable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な⟦{逆転勝|ぎゃくてんが}ち→逆転勝ち：08584_gyakutengachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧あっぱれ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ほか⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: The opposing team's brilliant comeback victory was so admirable that even as rivals, all you can say is 'bravo.'

notes:
An exclamation of admiration for something splendid, brave, or impressive. Originally from the classical Japanese {天晴|あっぱれ}, it carries a somewhat old-fashioned or dramatic tone.

USAGE:
- Can be used as an interjection ("Bravo!") or as an adjective (あっぱれな)
- Has a traditional, somewhat masculine feel
- Often used in sports commentary, historical dramas, and when praising bold actions
- Can be used with a touch of humor or irony

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- あっぱれな⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧: a splendid performance
- あっぱれな⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: an admirable attitude
- {天晴|あっぱれ}!: Bravo! Splendid! (kanji form)
- あっぱれ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ほか⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: one can only say "bravo"

ETYMOLOGY:
Derived from {天晴|あっぱれ}, literally "heavenly clearing," referring to a clear, bright sky. The metaphor extends to something so impressive it is like a clear sky — brilliant and undeniable.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧: splendid, magnificent — more neutral and modern
- お⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧: well done! — polite exclamation
- ⟦{素晴|すば}らしい→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧: wonderful, excellent — the standard modern equivalent
- ⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧: admirable, fine — focuses on respectability and worthiness
